mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 65 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library and a moderate air quality index of 52. We are in a first quarter moon phase, and you can catch the I S S crossing the sky tonight starting at 3:23 AM for one minute, traveling from the south over Belleville toward the east near Fitchburg.

The city has two major updates: the Department of Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician through September 20, and residents are reminded that sewer and stormwater utility rates have been adjusted to keep our infrastructure self-supporting and prevent system failures.
We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow and the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena on August 23.
In our weekly report, on Friday, August 15, officers responded to a call where a 44-year-old woman was found passed out behind the wheel of her vehicle, leading to an arrest for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so make sure to stop by then for your treat.
